blocks.orig: A Tanzania family safari is a one-of-a-kind opportunity to see incredible wild animals that you might only have glimpsed on TV or in books. View mighty lions, towering giraffes and massive elephants roaming free. In 4×4 safari vehicles, which we can adapt to your kids’ needs, you’ll discover national parks like the famous Serengeti, the massive Ngorongoro Crater and small gems like the Arusha National Park. Your children have a favourite African animal? Tell your guides and they’ll search for it!
blocks.html: A family safari in Tanzania is a rare chance to meet astonishing wild animals your children may only know from television or books. Watch mighty lions, tall giraffes and enormous elephants wander freely. Travelling in 4×4 safari vehicles, which we can adjust to suit your kids’ needs, you will explore national parks such as the renowned Serengeti, the vast Ngorongoro Crater and smaller treasures like Arusha National Park. Do your children have a favourite African animal? Let your guides know and they will go looking for it!

blocks.orig: If you happen to be in Tanzania at the right time, witnessing the Great Wildebeest Migration is a must-do. It’s one of the greatest natural spectacles on Earth, with over 1.5 million wildebeests and hundreds of thousands of zebras and gazelles in search of lush grazing grounds. Standing amidst the coordinated hordes of animals stampeding across rivers and plains is an unbelievable sight… and will leave your family in awe.
blocks.html: Should your visit to Tanzania fall at the right moment, seeing the Great Wildebeest Migration is something you cannot skip. It ranks among the greatest natural spectacles on the planet: more than 1.5 million wildebeests, joined by hundreds of thousands of zebras and gazelles, on the move in search of fresh grazing. Standing among those coordinated masses of animals thundering across rivers and plains is an incredible sight… one that will leave your whole family speechless.

blocks.orig: Savannah and paradise: the perfect match
blocks.html: Savannah plus paradise: a winning combination

blocks.orig: It may seem impossible to pull kids away from thrilling daily safari adventures, spotting lions, elephants and more wildlife up close. Yet the prospect of pristine beaches, turquoise waters, and relaxing days swimming, snorkelling, and building sandcastles may just do the trick.
blocks.html: Tearing the kids away from the daily excitement of safari, with lions, elephants and other wildlife up close, might sound impossible. But the promise of unspoilt beaches, turquoise sea and lazy days of swimming, snorkelling and building sandcastles could well do the trick.

blocks.orig: Combine the best of both worlds for your family holiday in Tanzania: first experience an unparalleled safari adventure and then enjoy an idyllic tropical beach getaway.
blocks.html: Give your family the best of both worlds in Tanzania: start with an unrivalled safari adventure and follow it with a dreamy tropical beach break.

blocks.orig: Family-friendly Zanzibar or more low-key alternatives like Mafia Island and Pemba are a great second act. Spend days chasing waves, feasting on fresh seafood BBQs on the beach, and letting kids make new friends while you enjoy island romance. This might just be the best 2-in-1-deal of your lifetime.
blocks.html: Family-friendly Zanzibar, or quieter options such as Mafia Island and Pemba, make a wonderful second act. Fill your days chasing waves, tucking into fresh seafood barbecues on the beach and watching the kids make new friends while you savour a little island romance. It may well be the best 2-in-1 deal you will ever get.

blocks.orig: Of course, you can also stay in explorer mode and spend your days on these beautiful islands with other thrilling activities. Your kids crave more animal memories? Then watch hundreds of baby turtles hatching at Mafia Island, or dolphins and whales making waves in the ocean. Or you explore old ruins, instagrammable caves and forests with Jungle Book vibes. These islands are so much more than sandy beaches and glistening water.
blocks.html: Naturally, you can also keep the explorer mode switched on and fill your days on these lovely islands with more exciting activities. Do your kids want even more animal memories? Then watch hundreds of baby turtles hatch on Mafia Island, or look out for dolphins and whales in the ocean. Or discover ancient ruins, caves made for Instagram and forests with a Jungle Book feel. There is far more to these islands than sandy beaches and sparkling water.

blocks.orig: What to do with your family in Tanzania?
blocks.html: Things to do with your family in Tanzania

blocks.orig: No matter if adventurous, fun or cultural: there’s a lot to do in Tanzania and its islands. Here are our hand-selected top three excursions to make your Tanzania family holiday one to remember.
blocks.html: Adventurous, fun or cultural: Tanzania and its islands have plenty to offer. These are our carefully chosen top three excursions for a Tanzania family holiday you will never forget.

blocks.orig: Hot air balloon safari: Soar over Tanzania’s epic landscapes in a hot air balloon for bird’s-eye views that thrill kids and adults alike. Float gently above salt flats and grassy savannahs, spotting wildlife roaming below, controlled by expert pilots. With premium views of Tanzania’s Eden, our hot air balloon rides create priceless shared memories.
blocks.html: Hot air balloon safari: Drift above Tanzania’s dramatic landscapes in a hot air balloon and enjoy a bird’s-eye view that delights children and grown-ups alike. Guided by experienced pilots, you float quietly over salt flats and grassy savannah while wildlife roams underneath. With these superb views over Tanzania’s Eden, our hot air balloon rides give your family memories to treasure together.

blocks.orig: Semi-submarine experience: Board a semi-submarine vessel and immerse your family in Zanzibar’s incredible underwater habitats and marine life. After a magical submerged realm tour, a speedboat whisks you to a castaway-style sandbank picnic with white sand beaches for sun-soaked swimming and snorkelling in aquamarine waters amongst tropical fish.
blocks.html: Semi-submarine experience: Step aboard a semi-submarine and let your family discover the remarkable underwater world and marine life of Zanzibar. After the magical tour below the surface, a speedboat carries you to a castaway-style picnic on a sandbank, where white sand and aquamarine water invite you to swim and snorkel among tropical fish in the sun.

blocks.orig: Visit a Maasai village: Learn more about Maasai traditions by visiting this fascinating tribe at home. Try spear-throwing with warriors, ride donkeys and dance like a Maasai! By experiencing the genuine Maasai lifestyle first-hand, your family connects deeply with this proud and welcoming tribe.
blocks.html: Visit a Maasai village: Get to know Maasai traditions by calling on this fascinating tribe where they live. Have a go at spear-throwing alongside the warriors, ride a donkey and dance the Maasai way! Experiencing the authentic Maasai way of life at first hand gives your family a real bond with this proud and hospitable people.
